description: Membership warehouse club selling groceries, household goods, and gasoline in bulk at thin markups, with growing e-commerce and delivery.

catalyst.facts_line: 2026-09-24 (Thursday, after the close), 5 days out -- from the earnings calendar, consensus EPS 6.53.
catalyst.why: The report must show e-commerce growth above 20% and a special dividend, confirming delivery expansion adds revenue without destroying margin.

reasons: E-commerce sales grew 20.9% in fiscal 2026 and 17.9% in August, yet consensus EPS is flat; delivery expansion via DoorDash and Uber Eats across 639 stores adds a new growth lever not in estimates.

August net sales rose 9.9% y/y to $23.70B, showing value-seeking consumers are trading into Costco even as overall spending intentions fall; warehouse clubs are projected to lead mass merchandiser growth in 2026.
Cash and equivalents rose 9.0% and EBIT rose 7.8% quarter-over-quarter, giving Costco room to announce a special dividend; the last four reports all beat consensus, so estimates are too low.

quants.eps_revisions: tilted higher, with 8 up and 4 down over last 30 days
extra: Last quarter cash and cash equivalents increasing 9% quarter over quarter (5/10/2026)
Last quarter earnings before interest and tax increasing 8% quarter over quarter (5/10/2026)

structuring.thesis_target: Targets the 2026-12-18 report, with the long leg expiring 2027-01-15, which gives the thesis time to show up.
structuring.reflection: The credit ratio clears the floor, but the net debit is $2,660 per spread; the short call at 930 caps upside if the special dividend sparks a gap. Size it small because the stock is already expensive and a miss would be ugly.
